definitions.explanation: A physical, mental, and spiritual practice originating from India, involving poses, breathing, and meditation.

examples.english: I do yoga in the morning.

examples.japanese: ヨガは{体|からだ}が{柔|やわ}らかくなる。
examples.english: Yoga makes your body more flexible.

examples.japanese: ヨガ{教室|きょうしつ}に{通|かよ}い{始|はじ}めた。

notes:
ヨガ (yoga) is a practice combining physical poses, breathing, and meditation, popular in Japan for health and relaxation.

SPELLING VARIANTS:
- ヨガ: common spelling
- ヨーガ: closer to Sanskrit pronunciation

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ヨガをする: to do yoga
- ヨガに{通|かよ}う: to attend yoga (classes regularly)
- ヨガ{教室|きょうしつ}: yoga class/studio
- ヨガマット: yoga mat
- ヨガウェア: yoga wear

TYPES OF YOGA:
- ホットヨガ: hot yoga
- パワーヨガ: power yoga
- マタニティヨガ: prenatal yoga

BENEFITS OFTEN MENTIONED:
- {体|からだ}が{柔|やわ}らかくなる: body becomes more flexible
- リラックスできる: can relax
- {姿勢|しせい}が{良|よ}くなる: posture improves
